load_msa.responsibility: Read the multiple-sequence alignment with BioPython AlignIO; drop all-gap columns; encode as uint8 (A,C,G,T,- -> 0..4).

window_similarity_profile.responsibility: Tile the alignment into n_win overlapping windows; for one genome i compute its normalized similarity S_i to all other genomes per window.

discover_parent_clusters.responsibility: Aggregate per-window kNN graphs across windows; spectral normalized-cut to discover C parent clusters, whole-genome assignments, and per-cluster per-column consensus (requires the alignment A, NOT just the similarity profiles — a length-L consensus cannot be reconstructed from similarities alone).

in.name: S_profiles
in.type: iterator of S_i arrays, each shaped n_win×n

in.name: A
in.type: numpy.uint8 alignment array (needed for the per-column consensus Q)

out.name: Q
out.type: numpy.float32 array (per-cluster per-column consensus base distributions)

per_genome_membership_path.responsibility: For one genome i, compute the per-window parent-cluster membership sequence c_i by argmax mean-similarity-to-cluster.

detect_change_points.responsibility: Run the dynamic-programming segmented-likelihood solver on c_i with a BIC penalty; return candidate breakpoint coordinates and segment assignments.

in.name: S_i
in.type: numpy.float32 array (soft profile for the LRT)

out.name: P
out.type: numpy.int32 array (parent-cluster id for each of the k_i+1 segments)

discordance_test.responsibility: The identifiability correction: for each candidate recombinant, build a small NJ tree per segment (Bio.Phylo, JC69) and run a two-tree-vs-one-tree local likelihood-ratio test; keep breakpoints only where the two-tree model wins (Bonferroni-corrected).

in.name: A_segments
in.type: list of two numpy.uint8 sub-alignments (the two recombinant segments at the breakpoint); each is a column-slice of A whose widths sum to L

null_calibration.responsibility: On the null DGP (no recombination), calibrate the LRT threshold to hold genome-level FPR at alpha; convert LRT statistics to calibrated p-values; Benjamini-Hochberg across genomes.

in.name: null_lrt_distribution
in.type: numpy.float32 vector of LRT statistics sampled from the null DGP

out.name: threshold
out.domain: LRT cutoff for mosaic call at target alpha

report_genome.responsibility: Assemble per-genome output: mosaic label z_i, breakpoint coordinates (in nt), parent assignments, confidence, low-signal/saturation flags.

acceptance_criteria.spec: WHEN the ADVERSARIAL-HOMOPLASY DGP regime is run (convergent tracts injected, NO true recombination) THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL achieve a genome-level false-positive rate <= 1%, AND the discordance_test SHALL classify >=90% of homoplasy tracts as is_discordant=False. EARS: IF convergent-evolution tracts are injected THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT label them mosaic.

WHEN a per-window saturation diagnostic (Shannon entropy of the substitution pattern) exceeds the saturation threshold THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL set saturation_flag=True for that genome/window AND SHALL down-weight any candidate breakpoint falling in a saturated window. EARS: WHEN window substitution entropy > tau_sat THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL flag saturation.

WHEN the ADVERSARIAL-SHORT-TRACT sweep runs (tract lengths {win_size/4, win_size/2, win_size, 2*win_size}) THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL report a detection floor (the minimum tract length at which recall >= 50%) and THAT floor SHALL be >= win_size/2 (documented limitation, not hidden). EARS: WHEN tract_length < win_size THEN THE SYSTEM MAY report 'no breakpoint detected' AND SHALL log the floor.

WHEN the ADVERSARIAL-WEAK sweep runs (sister-clade divergence {0.1%, 0.5%, 1%, 5%}) THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL report a power-vs-divergence curve AND SHALL flag near_identical_parents=True for recombinants between clades < 0.5% diverged (the not-identifiable regime). EARS: IF between-parent divergence < 0.5% THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL flag near_identical_parents (not silently call non-recombinant).

WHEN the ADVERSARIAL-GAPPY sweep runs (gap/N density {0, 5%, 20%, 40%}) THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL gate per-window informative-site-count (windows below threshold masked) AND breakpoints falling in gappy windows SHALL be flagged gappy=True. EARS: WHEN per-window informative-site-count < tau_info THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL mask the window.

WHEN the null DGP is generated WITH a Gamma-distributed site-rate prior (shape in {0.1, 0.5, 1.0}, no recombination, no convergence — pure rate heterogeneity over known hypervariable regions) THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL hold genome-level FPR <= 1% (rate-heterogeneity alone must not be called recombination), AND the discordance-test null SHALL be one-tree-WITH-rate-heterogeneity (not one-tree-JC69). EARS: WHEN substitution rates vary along the genome without recombination THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT call false breakpoints. If the +I+Gamma-calibrated null still over-segments hypervariable regions, this is reported as a documented_limitation rather than hidden.

WHEN the NULL DGP runs (zero recombinants injected, n=5000) THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL return z_i=0 for >= 99% of genomes (genome-level FPR <= 1%); this is the no-hallucination requirement. EARS: WHEN no recombination is present THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT hallucinate mosaics.

WHEN the method is given the TRUE parent-cluster labels (oracle upper bound) THEN breakpoint-localization accuracy (mean |b_hat - b_true|) SHALL be reported AND SHALL serve as the ceiling for the unsupervised path. EARS: WHEN oracle parents are provided THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL report the localization ceiling.

WHEN benchmarked against the no-recombination null baseline AND the single-global-breakpoint naive baseline (Category 5) on the true-recombination DGP THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL achieve mosaic-F1 at least 0.10 higher AND breakpoint-recall at least 0.15 higher than BOTH naive baselines; if it does not, the method has no utility over the simplest competitor (kill-switch).

WHEN run on n=5000 genomes (HIV 9.8kb and SARS-CoV-2 29.9kb) on a single CPU core THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL complete in <= 8 hours wall-clock AND <= 8 GB peak memory AND SHALL report per-genome cost; this is the T2 scalability axis that the cited classics (3SEQ/RDP5/GARD) do not reach at n=5000.

WHEN benchmarked on identical MSAs with identical held-out recombinant events (fresh parent pairs, simulator-only truth — no circular ground truth) against 3SEQ (Lam 2018), RDP5 (Martin 2021), and GARD (HyPhy) THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL be reported on mosaic-F1, breakpoint-localization, parent-assignment accuracy, FPR-on-null, runtime, and memory; the comparison is the T2 'defensibly better on >=1 axis' claim. The naive baselines (AC-NAIVE-BASELINES) are included in the same table.
